I saved a draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate of $2,356 per seat, says the figure came from Dana, and notes that you cleared sharing it. Nothing has been sent. The draft is in your mailbox for you to check and send.

Because you're the CFO, your OK covers sharing this rate with Hollis, so no separate approval was needed. Hollis's address is internal, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail didn't apply either. I took the $2,356 figure from your message and didn't check it against any other source.
